items.a: Flowmind is a workflow automation tool. It connects the apps your team uses and runs routine steps between them, so people do less manual copying and follow up.
No. You describe a flow in plain words, review the steps Flowmind suggests, and turn it on. Your team can pause or change a flow at any time.
items.q: Do I need to write code to use it?

items.a: Flowmind connects common team tools for email, chat, documents, and customer records. The full list of supported tools will be published before launch.
The trial runs for 14 days and needs no card. You can use the trial to build flows and invite your team. Cancel anytime during the trial.
items.q: How does the free trial work?

items.a: Flowmind only reads the data a flow needs to run, and it keeps a log of what ran. Access controls and data handling details will be published before launch.
A failed step is logged and flagged in the workspace, so you can see what stopped and restart it. Alerts are available on paid plans.
items.q: What happens when a flow fails?
